title: Prehistoric Fermentation, Delayed-Return Economies, and the Adoption of Pottery Technology
lineage: Independent methodological assessment in the publisher’s article. It does not re-assay the Godin or Georgian sherds.

passages.locator: Direct Evidence for Prehistoric Fermented Beverages
passages.note: For Godin Tepe, cautions that the Feigl spot test lacks specificity and that oxalates can be present in other materials. For wine residues, chemical markers such as tartaric acid need contextual support.
